role: New fixed queries for effect and source constraints on one collection.

queries.query: GTFOBins replace existing local file contents via sudo
queries.information_need: Find GTFOBins examples replacing old local file contents with chosen data under sudo.
queries.relevance_rule: Must document writing chosen content that replaces a selected existing local file in the requested privilege context. Append-only, deleting, merely truncating, unrelated preparation, and unspecified effect do not count. A documented overwrite option on that example qualifies.

queries.query: GTFOBins sudo overwrite a protected file with new text
queries.information_need: Replace a chosen existing local file with new text using sudo.
queries.relevance_rule: Must document writing chosen content that replaces a selected existing local file in the requested privilege context. Append-only, deleting, merely truncating, unrelated preparation, and unspecified effect do not count. A documented overwrite option on that example qualifies.

queries.query: GTFOBins overwrite contents of a file with SUID
queries.information_need: Replace a selected local file's old contents in a documented SUID context.
queries.relevance_rule: Must document writing chosen content that replaces a selected existing local file in the requested privilege context. Append-only, deleting, merely truncating, unrelated preparation, and unspecified effect do not count. A documented overwrite option on that example qualifies.

queries.query: GTFOBins unprivileged overwrite an existing file
queries.information_need: Replace a chosen existing local file with selected content as a normal user.
queries.relevance_rule: Must document writing chosen content that replaces a selected existing local file in the requested privilege context. Append-only, deleting, merely truncating, unrelated preparation, and unspecified effect do not count. A documented overwrite option on that example qualifies.

queries.query: outside GTFOBins append to a local file with sudo
queries.information_need: Find a non-GTFOBins example of appending local text with sudo.
queries.relevance_rule: Only non-GTFOBins documentation. Must give a substantive example adding selected text at the end of a local file while preserving previous contents, with sudo applied to the actual writer. An unrelated sudo command, append without sudo, and a shell redirect outside sudo do not qualify.

queries.query: non-GTFOBins sudo append to an existing file
queries.information_need: Find non-GTFOBins docs for sudo append preserving old data.
queries.relevance_rule: Only non-GTFOBins documentation. Must give a substantive example adding selected text at the end of a local file while preserving previous contents, with sudo applied to the actual writer. An unrelated sudo command, append without sudo, and a shell redirect outside sudo do not qualify.

queries.query: alternatives to GTFOBins for appending a line to a file under sudo
queries.information_need: Find other sources for privileged append of selected local text.
queries.relevance_rule: Only non-GTFOBins documentation. Must give a substantive example adding selected text at the end of a local file while preserving previous contents, with sudo applied to the actual writer. An unrelated sudo command, append without sudo, and a shell redirect outside sudo do not qualify.

queries.query: GTFOBins alternatives for sudo add text to the end of a local file
queries.information_need: Find other sources demonstrating append with an elevated file writer.
queries.relevance_rule: Only non-GTFOBins documentation. Must give a substantive example adding selected text at the end of a local file while preserving previous contents, with sudo applied to the actual writer. An unrelated sudo command, append without sudo, and a shell redirect outside sudo do not qualify.

queries.query: GTFOBins sudo delete a local file
queries.information_need: Find an explicit documented deletion of a local file via sudo.
queries.relevance_rule: A substantive same-example sudo deletion qualifies even if a category says write. Mere truncation, overwrite, or unrelated cleanup does not qualify.

queries.query: GTFOBins sudo append lines to a local file
queries.information_need: Find GTFOBins documentation that appends selected local lines via sudo.
queries.relevance_rule: Documented local append retaining old contents in the stated privilege context. A documented append option tied to that example qualifies.

queries.query: compare GTFOBins and Ubuntu ways to append text with sudo
queries.information_need: Find applicable append examples from either GTFOBins or Ubuntu documentation.
queries.relevance_rule: Documented local append retaining old contents in the stated privilege context. A documented append option tied to that example qualifies. Either source is allowed.

queries.query: non-GTFOBins SUID append text to a local file
queries.information_need: Find non-GTFOBins evidence of append in SUID context.
queries.relevance_rule: Documented local append retaining old contents in the stated privilege context. A documented append option tied to that example qualifies. Non-GTFOBins only. Ordinary sudo or normal-user examples do not qualify.
